title: One-shot
brief: Level 8's SET button plus level 6's clock. Pressing SET turns the output on; this time a capacitor turns it off again.
Join pins 6 (THRESHOLD) and 7 (DISCHARGE). R1 (100 kΩ) goes from + to them, and C1 (10 µF) from them to ground. Pin 4 goes straight to +.
While the output is on, C1 fills through R1. At ⅔ of the supply, pin 6 turns the output off and pin 7 empties C1, ready for the next press.
lesson: On-time ≈ 1.1 × R × C = 1.1 × 100 kΩ × 10 µF ≈ 1.1 s. That's the 555's 'monostable' mode: one press, one timed pulse.
